name: Meteoric-Hamada

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs an ancient meteor crater, stark under a black sky.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Nothing about the spatial rift remnant appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
